pr_title: Add Human Readable Error Message for Object::set_meta
pr_body:
Fixes: #70141 

Updates a call from a non-descriptive error macro to one that is easier to understand for the typical user.

_Bugsquad edit:_ [This PR](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/76477) exists for the docs change
pr_comments: @sfrembling Also both PR/commit titles: *"updated error message to be more human readable"* are too vague. I suggest something like *"Add human readable error message for Object::set_meta"* instead.
@kleonc I went ahead and made those changes you mentioned. I definitely agree with the code change; bringing that information to the user will make things easier to debug. Thanks for the suggestions.

@sfrembling Note you've changed the PR title, but not the commit title. Also now there are 2 commits but a single commit is preferred for keeping the git history clean. So please squash the commits and change the title. You can do so by rebasing, for how-to [see the docs](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/4.0/contributing/workflow/pr_workflow.html#the-interactive-rebase). In the interactive rebase you'd want to do something like:
```
reword e620a43 updated error message to be more human readable
fixup 405fde2 Update core/object/object.cpp 
```
Besides that looks good to me.
@kleonc, went ahead and went through with your advice. Are we all good to merge now?

> This should include the information "metadata" in the error message, so something like "Invalid metadata identifier:" IMO

Anything else anyone can think of for this change?
Thanks! And I think this was your first merged Godot PR, so congrats!

issue_context.title: Can't set meta by get_instance_id()
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

v4.0.beta8.official [45cac42c0]

### System information

Windows 10, 64bit

### Issue description
Can't set meta by `get_instance_id()`
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/35988767/208062138-3259c2f7-9729-47bf-afaa-503b8c9b5870.png)


### Steps to reproduce

/

### Minimal reproduction project

[MetaTest.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/10244219/MetaTest.zip)
comments: Meta data's name should be a valid identifier. A valid identifier can't start with a number, thus the error.
The error message can be improved to be more human-readable then.
OK, thanks, should I close this issue? @timothyqiu
@CsloudX I think this requirement can be documented, and the error message can be improved just like @rburing said.

review_comments:
```suggestion
		ERR_FAIL_COND_MSG(!p_name.operator String().is_valid_identifier(), vformat("Invalid metadata identifier: '%s'.", p_name));
```

We use `vformat` to format strings.
I have been overruled on this.
